title_seed: 合法 OA 也可能只是 landing page
central_problem: legal route、payload format、identity 與 semantic qualification 如何逐層驗證？
reader_takeaway: 修正一個 false negative，不等於放寬所有 abstract、landing 或 scanned payload。

known_at_the_time.fact: OA materialization V2 used bytes/MIME/HTML/JATS/TEI/PDF detection, bounded landing-to-full-text resolution and strict identity verification。
fresh current-live coverage improved to 2/10 qualifying full-text cases while the >=8/10 gate remained unmet。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: a narrow PMC identity false-negative repair was added while abstract, landing, scanned, paywall, wrong-article and weak-identity payloads remained rejected。

not_yet_available.fact: format detection and controlled fixtures passing do not establish broad live OA coverage。

observed_failures.symptom: previous payloads included HTML articles, scanned PDFs, landing pages, abstract-only and binary-unknown classes
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: format/identity/qualification signals had been conflated or insufficiently persisted
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: only positive identity plus substantive structure could qualify
observed_failures.later_resolution: format-aware qualification repaired only the evidenced narrow false-negative path

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The OA materialization V2 cohort qualified 2/10 cases and passed 20/20 controlled fixture scenarios.
tests_and_metrics.result: controlled behavior passed; live coverage stayed limited

engineering_decisions.decision: 先保存 payload evidence 與 identity evidence，再由單一 qualification owner 決定；不以 HTTP status 或 title-only match 放寬。

architecture_state.state: legal route → bytes/MIME detection → format materialization → identity binding → semantic qualification

safe_public_facts.fact: 合法可取得不代表拿到的 payload 就是該篇研究的完整正文；route、identity、format 與 structure 都要驗。

retrospective_notes.note: V6A 後來再把 admitted manifestation 與 current admission revision 綁在一起；本日只使用 OA V2 evidence。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: format, identity and live coverage evidence

publication_risks: 不要列出可讓讀者直接下載的未授權 URL。
